feed.title: Scarface decomp: new matches
feed.subtitle: Functions of Scarface: The World Is Yours rebuilt in C++ that compiles to the exact same bytes.

entry.title: sub_002CE560 (Xbox, 75 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Releases a string's text: one fewer user, and when it was the last, gives its memory back (never the shared empty one). 0x002CE560 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_00073400 (Xbox, 85 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Adds an object to the 127-bucket table its name key picks (clearing the table first the first time). 0x00073400 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.
